tools.name: discover
tools.description: Semantic search across the index of available Salesforce operations. Returns a ranked set of candidate operations for a natural-language request.

query.description: Natural-language description of what you want to do.

limit.description: Maximum number of results, 1 to 50. Default 10.

domain.description: Optional domain filter, for example platform, commerce or service.

resultType.description: endpoint for individual API operations, sor for multi-step Setup Operation Recipes.

tools.name: describe
tools.description: Returns the technical contract for an operation: APIs, parameters, dependencies and ordered steps.

id.description: The qualified operation Id or SOR Id to describe.

tools.name: dispatch
tools.description: Invokes the chosen operation. Can change org configuration or data, so confirm changes with the user first.

headers.description: Optional HTTP headers as key-value pairs.

body.description: Optional request body for POST, PUT and PATCH.

queryParams.description: Optional query parameters as key-value pairs.

tools.name: dispatch_readonly
tools.description: Invokes the chosen operation in read-only mode. Never changes data or configuration.

headers.description: Optional HTTP headers as key-value pairs.

queryParams.description: Optional query parameters as key-value pairs.
